peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.statement: Price position — In line with comparable condos: 4.1% below its local comparables; 17 of 44 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Around peers (58.8): 5.1 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 29 of 51 similar developments (the same as 2). Context, not scored: resales in 54.2% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments
lines.statement: 1-bedroom: median $944,000 ($1,790 psf, 527 sq ft; 6 resales, Feb 2024–Jan 2026); 8 comparable developments within 3 km: median $1,866 psf (range $1,746–2,101); 4.1% below; illustrative entry-price difference about $40,000 less. The entry-price difference is illustrative: the median price adjusted to the comparable median psf, for a similar-size unit. A premium or a discount is not in itself an advantage or a disadvantage.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Potong Pasir MRT about 170 m, Geylang Bahru MRT about 940 m; closer than 37 of 51 similar developments (the same as 1). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 3 within 1 km and 7 within 2 km; nearest St Andrew's School (Junior) about 500 m; more than 48 of 51 similar developments (the same as 1). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 2 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 400 m), more than 6 of 51 similar developments (the same as 6); nearest hawker centre Blk 69 Geylang Bahru Market And Food Centre about 910 m; nearest park Greenway South about 510 m. Straight-line distances.

nearestHawker.name: Blk 69 Geylang Bahru Market And Food Centre

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 1 other condo development sold new homes within 2 km (The Arcady at Boon Keng, 32 new sales, about 930 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 114 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 32 new sales and 631 resales (663 purchases); new sales were 4.8% of these purchases. Subsales (54) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: Within 2 km: Kallang Close GLS site (government land sale site, awarded), about 1,910 m. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 631 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 28 of 51 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 631 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 703 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−10.2%). Planning-area private resales −13.1%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
